english.title: Fail to comply with requirements of a CVED in movement of animal products

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) where a consignment of products specified in Commission Decision 2007/275/EC, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCTS..), and box number **(..SPECIFY BOX NUMBER..) the Common Veterinary Entry Document (CVED) required a consignment to be taken to a specific destination in the European Union

(A)_[failed to ensure that the movement was under customs supervision as specified in the CVED]_
(B)_[being the occupier of the premises of consignment, failed to immediately notify the Secretary of State of its arrival]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17, 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
consignment of products specified in Commission Decision 2007/275/EC

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
